The '''Ghostling Nest of the Assembler''' was a giant tubular-shaped web that drifted through space.<ref name="DM">{{DB|character|kudarmubat|Mub'at, Kud'ar}}</ref> It was built by [[Assembler]] [[Kud'ar Mub'at]] who lived there with his [[subnode]]s.<ref name="TMA" /> The Ghostling Nest was destroyed by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and the [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] during the [[Bounty Hunter Wars]]. Boba Fett and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] partially rebuilt the web by the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="HM" /> and the Ghostling Nest was eventually used by [[Balancesheet]] in some occasions.<ref name="TEGtW" />
